# Package abstract bounded scalar calls

Owned source and SDK layouts retain a package abstract declaration with one
method-owned plain class bound and a primitive result. The generic caller has
its own separate class formal, a private branch and arithmetic after dispatch.
A future implementation compiled with the frozen observer supplies a different
opaque result while preserving the original abstract slot.

Six routes, two implementations and twelve modes run twice in each fresh JVM.
They check the receiver captured before argument evaluation, replacement of its
field during that evaluation, null receiver timing, input identity, partial
writes, virtual dispatch, integer overflow, skipped branches, and exact checked,
runtime and Error propagation. Independent wrong programs qualify the observer.
Eight same-Code Signature controls retain their exact scoped declaration through
D8 or a separate SDK provider. Every emitted unit compiles and every original
class, method, Code role, access, Signature, Exceptions and parameter is checked.
